emergency: Emergencies: go to the ER or call your country's number. If there is immediate risk, do not wait.
es024: Spain's 24/7, free and anonymous suicide-prevention line.
us988: U.S. crisis and suicide lifeline, 24/7, free.
samhsa: U.S. referral line for mental health and substance use treatment, 24/7, English and Spanish.
ca988: Canada crisis line by phone, text or chat, 24/7.
saptel: Mexico emotional support line, 24/7, free and confidential.
ar135: Mental health line for Buenos Aires City.
cl600: Mental health guidance from Chile's public health network.
co106: Colombia crisis care and health guidance line.
pe113: Peru Ministry of Health mental health line.
cvv: Life-valuation center: listening and support in Brazil, 24/7.
samaritans: Free, confidential listening in the UK and Ireland, 24/7.
telefonoamico: Italy crisis listening line, free and confidential.
findahelpline: International directory of verified helplines by country and topic.
iasp: International Association for Suicide Prevention: country resources.
